criterion_text: A RegistryService mounted on Server-like and Agent-like fixture hosts responds to standard OCI Pull endpoints, including Manifest/Index, tag resolution, HEAD, Range, content negotiation and OCI error semantics; ORAS/OCI client readback matches original object digests.
